body:
Add a fitted live-state win-probability model and a fourth statistics page for live spectators. Each pre-game alliance shares one predicted chance. The page fits all sixteen colonies at 640×480; drawing consumes predictions copied into the extracted Scene, preserving the simulation-thread boundary. Evaluate the published coefficients with deterministic integer arithmetic and include the fitter and timeline reader. The optional match-ending rule is #363.

Rebased onto the updated shared estimator (#358) and current master; adapted to SDL3 and the current source inventory. The alliance reader also accepts a loss mask so the optional rule can keep its inputs stable while assigning outcomes. Ordinary spectator reads still exclude eliminated teams. Also correct the rebased custom-game start-quality translation key, which the selected screen test found was double-wrapped. 

Local validation of stack revision 509551aa on Linux/GCC 15.2: 1,142 headless native cases pass, with 90 display-dependent cases skipped; both affected custom-game/statistics display checks pass separately. All eight production CLI tests, the shared JavaScript corpus, 51 Python estimator/model/telemetry tests and CI policy/concurrency/Scene boundary checks pass. ThreadSanitizer completes 600 threaded headless ticks and 300 windowed ticks without race reports. CLI checks compare complete per-tick records across a checkpoint reload with the rule enabled. The catalog case finishes in 264 seconds, within its normal 600-second limit, and the unchanged fertility CPU-budget assertion passes. The maintainer explicitly authorized merging on passing relevant local tests while hosted CI is impaired; hosted GCC 13, foreign platforms, browsers and cross-platform checksum agreement remain unverified.

The coefficients and reported calibration come from the original 1,110-game campaign at 21a9fba9a. That campaign has not been rerun against current AI/rules or human play; the guide states this limit. The spectator page changes presentation only. Historical screenshots were removed from committed documentation; current captures and executable evidence are retained on the evidence branch.

[Validation evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/codex/probability-victory-evidence) includes exact command arguments, saved games, replays, per-tick checksum records, JUnit results and current screenshots.

Later integration revision 7ded1349 passed 617 unit cases and the completed engine groups, including all probability, save/replay and verifier cases, plus both refreshed ThreadSanitizer games. The maintainer explicitly requested stopping repeated suites and merging ASAP; the full run was stopped before the unrelated catalog case completed. This final restack incorporates current master’s farm AI and fog changes; only the build and required golden-record regeneration are refreshed afterward. Prior checks retain their exact revision provenance on the evidence branch.
